tests.title: parses declared defaults, shorthand, integer expressions and ranges with no cross-option check
binarises masked planes into owned tight planes without mutating padded input
outputs the empty frame filled with min(fill, 255) when the selected-plane sum reaches sum * plane area
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, settings and cancellation explicitly
plans maskfun on linear, graph and actor paths, refuses bad options before frames and refuses runtime commands
matches native linear maskfun thresholds, plane masks and empty frames across every executable format and size
matches native maskfun CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the linear path with and without -ss/-t, including implicit conversions
matches native maskfun with default threads and with -filter_threads 1
matches native maskfun filter_complex branches on the graph path in rawvideo and framecrc
matches native maskfun on the stream path through replay execution and the multi-input CLI
matches native maskfun through the timed backend on the actor and timed paths in rawvideo and framecrc
fails like native for out-of-range maskfun options before opening any output on every path
negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses the packed-alpha gbrap picks before output on every path
(registration-driven, unedited: 8 tests pass with maskfun registered)

unsupported: High-bit-depth formats (9-16 bit; maskfun16/getsum16) and yuv440p, yuv411p, yuv410p, yuvj440p, yuvj411p, yuva422p, yuva444p, gbrap: no frame storage, refused by name at negotiation
Packed RGB with alpha (rgba, bgra, argb, abgr) negotiates gbrap natively: refused before output on every path
Runtime commands (low, high, planes, fill, sum, enable): refused by the activation actors

proposedContracts.name: matches native linear maskfun thresholds, plane masks and empty frames across every executable format and size
proposedContracts.scope: gray, yuv420p, yuv422p, yuv444p, yuva420p, gbrp x 1x1/2x2/5x3/7x5/8x6/17x9 x 8 option sets (defaults, low=0:high=255, low=100:high=50, planes=1, planes=5, fill=77:sum=0, sum=255, fill=300:sum=0:planes=2), 3 frames each; 643 empty and 221 binarised frames

proposedContracts.name: matches native maskfun CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the linear path with and without -ss/-t, including implicit conversions
proposedContracts.scope: -vf rawvideo and framecrc, with and without -ss 0.04 -t 0.04, eight sources including nv12/rgb24 conversions under -cpuflags 0

proposedContracts.name: matches native maskfun with default threads and with -filter_threads 1
proposedContracts.scope: native default threads equals -filter_threads 1 equals EdgeFFmpeg

proposedContracts.name: matches native maskfun filter_complex branches on the graph path in rawvideo and framecrc
proposedContracts.scope: -filter_complex split branches with two outputs, rawvideo and framecrc

proposedContracts.name: matches native maskfun on the stream path through replay execution and the multi-input CLI
matches native maskfun through the timed backend on the actor and timed paths in rawvideo and framecrc
proposedContracts.scope: timed backend producer (actor) and pull (timed) schedulers, rawvideo and framecrc

proposedContracts.name: fails like native for out-of-range maskfun options before opening any output on every path
proposedContracts.scope: out-of-range low/high/planes/fill/sum refused like native with no output opened

proposedContracts.name: negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses the packed-alpha gbrap picks before output on every path
proposedContracts.scope: native picks from 17 sources; packed-alpha gbrap picks refused by name on every path

notes: Integer-only; no linux-x64 gated cases. Differential file runs in about 5 s on the sandbox.
The empty frame carries the input pts and the input metadata (native allocates it from the input link, so SAR and colour properties are the link's).

Setup: Node 24 could not be installed in the sandbox (install not permitted), so npm run bootstrap refused (Node.js 24+ is required); the documented fallback was used: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg (41 s), npm ci (8 s), npm run reference:build (3 m 13 s). Baseline typecheck, lint, boundaries and registry test (8 passed) took 1 m 26 s. Node v22.23.5.
The sandbox reference is a linux x64 build of 946fcce0 with --disable-x86asm; no binary sha is pinned in tests.
